themes.summary: Users are reporting occasional crashes during the KYC process and slow loading times on the dashboard.
themes.quote: The app keeps closing when I try to upload my PAN card. Very frustrating.

themes.summary: Feedback suggests the new portfolio view is slightly cluttered, with requested improvements for font clarity.
themes.quote: Love the features but the text is a bit too small on the main screen.

themes.summary: A subset of users is seeking clearer breakdowns for US Stock withdrawal charges and conversion rates.
themes.quote: I wasn't aware of the hidden 5$ withdrawal fee. Please make it more visible.
